summary: Postinstall script in package using Solana-aligned scope name
details: Package declares a postinstall lifecycle hook that executes install.js on install (`"postinstall": "node install.js"` in package.json line 7). The contents and behavior of install.js were not traced in this analysis, so the action performed at install time is not characterized. The package name uses the @solana-labs/web3.js coordinate, which collides with the canonical Solana JavaScript SDK that is published under @solana/web3.js — a name-confusion shape that warrants human review even absent a confirmed payload. Routing to review so a human can inspect install.js and confirm whether this is a legitimate Solana Labs release, an early/abandoned variant, or a name-collision lure.
